most_likely.text: Isles Super League is the league most likely to see a home win: 55.3% of 85 matches (90% range 46-64%), against 38.8% in Meridian League. The ranges overlap, so treat the order as a lean, not a finding.

Meridian League is the league most likely to see a draw: 38.8% of 85 matches (90% range 31-48%), against 24.7% in Calder Coast Premier. The ranges overlap, so treat the order as a lean, not a finding.

Calder Coast Premier is the league most likely to see an away win: 27.1% of 85 matches (90% range 20-36%), against 18.8% in Isles Super League. The ranges overlap, so treat the order as a lean, not a finding.
Calder Coast Premier is the league most likely to see over 2.5 goals: 54.1% of 85 matches (90% range 45-63%), against 32.9% in Northmarch Division.
Northmarch Division is the league most likely to see under 2.5 goals: 67.1% of 85 matches (90% range 58-75%), against 45.9% in Calder Coast Premier.

Calder Coast Premier is the league most likely to see both teams to score: 56.5% of 85 matches (90% range 48-65%), against 41.2% in Northmarch Division. The ranges overlap, so treat the order as a lean, not a finding.

Calder Coast Premier is the league most likely to see a goal after the 80th minute: 35.3% of 85 matches (90% range 27-44%), against 24.7% in Northmarch Division. The ranges overlap, so treat the order as a lean, not a finding.
Northmarch Division is the league most likely to see a red card: 28.2% of 85 matches (90% range 21-37%), against 12.9% in Isles Super League.

Meridian League is the league most likely to see the team that conceded first avoiding defeat: 31.8% of 85 matches (90% range 24-41%), against 22.4% in Northmarch Division. The ranges overlap, so treat the order as a lean, not a finding.

Northmarch Division is the league most likely to see at least one clean sheet: 58.8% of 85 matches (90% range 50-67%), against 43.5% in Calder Coast Premier. The ranges overlap, so treat the order as a lean, not a finding.
